description: The file defines an interface 'UriInterface' in the PSR (PHP Standards Recommendation) namespace, representing the value object for URIs. It includes method signatures for accessing and modifying URI components such as scheme, authority, user info, host, port, path, query, and fragment, following RFC 3986 specifications.

classes.name: UriInterface
classes.description: An interface representing a URI value object, outlining methods for retrieving and modifying URI components as per RFC 3986, intended for use in HTTP messages and other contexts needing URI manipulation.

methods.name: getScheme
methods.description: Retrieve the scheme component of the URI.

methods.name: getAuthority
methods.description: Retrieve the authority component of the URI.

methods.name: getUserInfo
methods.description: Retrieve the user information component of the URI.

methods.name: getHost
methods.description: Retrieve the host component of the URI.

methods.name: getPort
methods.description: Retrieve the port component of the URI.

methods.name: getPath
methods.description: Retrieve the path component of the URI.

methods.name: getQuery
methods.description: Retrieve the query string of the URI.

methods.name: getFragment
methods.description: Retrieve the fragment component of the URI.

methods.name: withScheme
methods.description: Return an instance with the specified scheme.

methods.name: withUserInfo
methods.description: Return an instance with the specified user information.

methods.name: withHost
methods.description: Return an instance with the specified host.

methods.name: withPort
methods.description: Return an instance with the specified port.

methods.name: withPath
methods.description: Return an instance with the specified path.

methods.name: withQuery
methods.description: Return an instance with the specified query string.

methods.name: withFragment
methods.description: Return an instance with the specified URI fragment.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Return the string representation of the URI reference.
